lines.beaver_en: Minsu, did you get a graduation gift ready?
lines.en: Yes, I'm going to give our teacher a notebook.

lines.beaver: 와, 수첩 좋네요. 다른 것도 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, a notebook is nice. Anything else?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, sucheop jonneyo. dareun geotdo isseoyo?
lines.en: I bought a pencil case too. I put an eraser in it.
Yes, I'm really grateful to our teacher.

lines.beaver_en: That's right. Any news about our class?
lines.learner: 네, 우리 반 친구 다섯 명이 대학에 가요.
lines.en: Yes, five classmates are going to college.
lines.roman: ne, uri ban chingu daseot myeongi daehage gayo.

lines.en: Jisu is going to Hanguk University.

lines.beaver_en: What about you, Minsu? Did you pick a major?

lines.en: Thanks. I'll talk to our teacher about it too.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Did you tell our friends too?
lines.en: Yes, I told our classmates too.

lines.beaver_en: Then let's give the gifts together on Friday.
lines.en: Sounds good. See you in the classroom on Friday.
